features.title: Changed-files card and review tab
features.summary: The native "Edited N files" card under a turn, its per-file hover comparison, the right-sidebar review tab, delivery cards and closing-prose file mentions, from one owned fork of the stock row.
features.currentSurface: chat transcript: the card under a turn that edited files, and the review tab it opens

onboarding.firstAction: Ask the agent to edit a file, then open a row of the Edited files card under its reply.
onboarding.doneWhen: The file's changes show under the row or in the review tab.

failureModes: A summary the Host no longer serves (Session disposed, Host restarted) shows that the turn's changes are no longer available.
A failed comparison read shows a Retry button.

telemetry.reason: The routes are the native ones registered through Connection's authenticated fetch; the comparisons are computed by core workspaceChanges, which owns their spans.

verification.reason: Every vendored file equals the pinned tag (node scripts/native-fork-diff.mjs deliverables).
